Claim amendment · 2026-11-14T23:01Z · to claim 6885536750. `File surface:` now also takes `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts` and its tests. Reason (dev's read on `f068cde8`): `ensureConversation` resolves `undefined` both when the create failed and when the request is only recorded, and a recorded create that later fails in `settlePending` → `createFor` is reported to nobody, so the order's failure leg (text back in the composer, bubble removed) has no signal inside `console/ai/**`. The fix surfaces the create failure from the producer (a returned create error tagged not-sent, like the object chat's send failures), so the existing restore and send-error notice run unchanged. Still app-shell only, private, and outside every other seat's live files. Nothing else in the claim changes.
